mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (monetary tightening) raises discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% in the past month signals a broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decline > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) exceeding 0.3% and a rise in FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.1% signals aggressive monetary policy in response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rise as specified, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% and HOUST growth rate > 1.0% in the past quarter), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth and economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth > 3.0% and HOUST growth > 1.0%.
